UPPSC Lecturer Technical Education Admit Card 2026

UPPSC Advt. No : A-11/E-1/2025: Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin :02/12/2025
  • Last Date for Apply Online :02/01/2026  
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date :02/01/2026
  • Exam Date : 06/09/2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : 225/-
  • SC / ST  : 105/-
  • PH Candidates : 25/-
  • Pay the Exam Fee Through SBI Mops Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or SBI E Challan Mode

UPPSC Lecturer Technical Education Online Form 2025: Age Limit as on 01/07/2025

  • Minimum Age Limit : 21 Years
  • Maximum Age Limit : 40 Years
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per UPPSC Lecturer Technical Education Advt No : A-11/E-1/2025.

UPPSC Lecturer Technical Education Recruitment 2025: Vacancy Details Total : 513 Post
Post Name Total Post UPPSC Lecturer Technical Education Eligibility
Lecturer Technical Education 513
  • BE / B.Tech Degree in Related Trade / Subject with First Class OR Bachelor and Master Degree in Relevant Disciplines.
  • For More Details Read the Notification.
  • One time registration (OTR) system is applicable in Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission. Candidates will have to do OTR first and only after that they will be able to apply.
  • Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission UPPSC Lecturer Technical Education Examination 2025 Recruitment. Candidate Can Apply Between 02 December 2025 to 02 January 2026
  • Candidate Read the Notification Before Apply the Recruitment Application Form in UPPSC Apply Online for Lecturer Technical Education Examination Exam 2025
  • Kindly Check and College the All Document – Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details.
  • Kindly Ready Scan Document Related to Recruitment Form – Photo, Sign, ID Proof, Etc.
  • Before Submit the Application Form Must Check the Preview and All Column Carefully.
  • Take A Print Out of Final Submitted Form. For the latest updates on Sarkari Result, admit card, answer key, and result, always visit SarkariResult.com, the official website for Sarkari Result in India (Since 2012).
